record.reason: 要旨は「Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address」を扱い、対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率・推論時圧縮への寄与を示していない。
record.title: A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
